title: Existing work orders bill their own customer after the release
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use the production test account.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, created on production before the release.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, open, made on production before the release, with its estimate total noted before the release.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Open the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer, reading "This customer".

Step 3:

  • The estimate total equals the total noted before the release.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • Feature Overview, Release day: “Nothing is migrated. Every existing work order, part sale and invoice already has one customer in both roles, so every total, balance, report and document matches the day before.”
  • Feature Overview, Release day: “Users who can change a work order's customer see a "Bill To" field reading "This customer" on every work order and part sale Customer card (Story 3).”
  • Goals: “A shop that never picks a different Bill To sees every total, balance, report and document unchanged.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs records made on production before the release reaches production; run on production after the release
